findings_addressed.oracle: SignalRecorder connected to panel.tool_started before calling start_tool(); asserts recorder.times_called == 1, independently verifying the signal wired in AnalysisPanelBase.start_tool() actually fires.

findings_addressed.oracle: Two independent oracles: (1) SignalRecorder on tool_closed asserts exactly one emission; (2) panel._status_poll_timer.isActive() asserts False after stop_tool(), proving SandboxPanel._cleanup() ran and stopped the timer.
